title: My first weeks in MDS
text:
The first few weeks of the Master of Data Science program have gone by pretty quickly. Orientation was a good chance to meet some of my classmates and get a better idea of what the year would look like. It was a little strange going from finishing my Computer Engineering degree to starting another program at UBC so soon after, but it was also exciting to have a fresh start and meet a completely new group of people.
The first week of classes was definitely a bit overwhelming. There was a lot of new material to take in, especially with Python, R, Git, and Quarto all being used together. What surprised me most was how quickly we were expected to start applying these tools rather than just learning them individually. I’m still getting used to the pace, but I’m starting to get a better sense of how everything fits together.
Outside of class, I went on a hike up Mount Brunswick over the weekend. It was a nice break from sitting at my computer and a good way to reset after the first week. I’m still figuring out what my routine will look like during MDS, but so far I’m feeling a mix of excited, challenged, and a little nervous about what’s ahead.

title: About Me
text: I grew up in Vancouver and studied Computer Engineering at the University of British Columbia. During my degree, I had the opportunity to work in both technical and customer-facing environments. I spent over a year as a full-stack developer at a small 3D printing company, where I worked on web applications and tools used by customers. I also worked in retail at Fjallraven and also as a Kumon instructor, which gave me experience working with people and solving problems outside of a purely technical setting.

title: About Me
text:
Why Data Science
I became interested in data science because I enjoy finding patterns in information and using them to answer questions. Sports have been a big part of this interest. I have followed hockey and basketball for years, and I’ve found myself naturally paying attention to statistics, player performance, and fantasy sports. The MDS program gives me an opportunity to build stronger skills in statistics, programming, and data analysis while exploring how I can apply them to areas that I genuinely enjoy.

title: About Me
text:
Outside of Data Science
Outside of school, I spend a lot of my time playing and watching sports. I enjoy tennis, ultimate frisbee, hiking, and following many different sport leagues. I have also been involved with Scouts for many years and currently volunteer as a Venturer Advisor, where I help organize activities and outdoor trips for youth. On weekends, I usually prefer doing something active or getting outside rather than staying home. I enjoy hiking, camping, exploring new places, and trying different restaurants with friends and family. I also like travelling and finding opportunities to experience places that are different from Vancouver.

title: Ivan Tse
text: Hello my name is Ivan! I am born and raised in Vancouver with my family coming from Hong Kong. I studied Computer Engineering in my undergrad here at UBC and graduated just recently in 2026! In this program, I’m hoping to gain the ability to work with data especially within sports as I’ve always had a strong interest in sports and want to combine my two interests.
